summary: Jasper Therapeutics, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 16, 2026, reporting its acquisition of Kira Pharmaceuticals via a merger. Jasper issued approximately 5.2 million common shares and 4.6 million non-voting convertible preferred shares (each convertible into 61 common shares) to Kira shareholders. Kira options were assumed. The merger is intended as a tax-free reorganization. No cash consideration, premium, or per-share price was disclosed. The board recommendation and advisors were not named. The deal closed on the filing date. To watch: conversion mechanics and dilution impact on Jasper common stock.
